_note: Short recommendations for each problem the diagnosis detects. The engine picks them by rules (not AI) and a local agronomist should review them. Each text completes the sentence 'One idea to improve it: ...', so it starts in lowercase with a verb. At most the first two of each list are used. User-facing text is in English.

suelo_descubierto.titulo: The field spends months without a crop
acciones: sow a cover crop in the months the field is left empty
add a winter crop such as wheat or barley

erosion_alta.titulo: Erosion is above the tolerable level
acciones: keep the soil covered all year, especially on slopes
check with an agronomist whether terraces or contour sowing make sense
include a crop that leaves plenty of stubble, such as maize, sorghum or wheat

sin_nitrogeno.titulo: Nothing adds nitrogen to the soil
acciones: include a legume cover crop such as vetch, or a pasture with clover
rotate plant families, for example a cereal and a legume
avoid growing the same crop two years in a row in the same paddock

deficit_agua.titulo: Water runs short in dry years
acciones: include crops that handle drought better, such as sorghum
leave stubble on the surface to store more water in the soil

deficit_critico.titulo: Water runs short at the most sensitive stage
acciones: review the sowing date with an agronomist so flowering doesn't fall in the driest months
consider varieties with a different cycle, or supplementary irrigation
review the sowing date with an agronomist so flowering avoids the hottest days
adjust the sowing date so heading doesn't coincide with late frosts
avoid sensitive crops in the field's low spots
consider a second cash crop in the year, if water and the market allow it
add a winter forage crop or a pasture for more forage
